newsitem.title: USA: Viisage unit in China smart-card deal.
newsitem.headline: Viisage unit in China smart-card deal.

text.p: Viisage Technology Inc said Friday its Viisage Technology Co Ltd, China unit had entered into an exclusive agreement valued at $1 million with China Jon Son group.
Under the pact, Viisage is to develop and produce "smart cards" for a program under which motor vehicle drivers who are stopped for violations pay any resulting fines on the spot.
Viisage said the contract is the first of a series of identification and smart-card projects it is developing in China.

"Based on projects we have in the pipeline, we anticipate substantial growth in the Chinese market once we achieve full production capacity in our Tianjin production facility," Viisage Chief Executive Bob Hughes said in a statement.
Viisage makes turnkey digital identification systems to deter fraud and improve security. Its 1996 full-year revenues were $25 million.
